lines.en: label dormwarssix9:
scene rocketshadowlegends
You thought you could get rid of us but THINK AGAIN! We spent loads of ROCKET MONEY on these ad slots and we’ll be DAMNED if we can’t get you to WATCH them!
lines.zh: 你以为能甩掉我们？再想想吧！我们花了大把 ROCKET MONEY 买下这些广告位，要是没法逼你们看下去，我们就该死！

lines.en: Just think of how HORRIBLE it would be to repeatedly DO something that goes UNNOTICED because people are trying to get to the GOOD PARTS! FUCK YOU! Advertisements are people TOO!
lines.zh: 想想看，一遍遍做着某件事却无人注意，只因为大家只想直奔精彩部分——那该有多惨！操你的！广告也是人啊！

lines.en: And when people get hungry, they EAT. When people get horny, they FUCK! FEED US! FUCK US! BUILD AN ARBY’S ON THE MOON!
lines.zh: 人饿了就吃。人发情了就操！喂饱我们！操我们！在月球上建一家 ARBY’S！

lines.en: Because if WE don’t do it, SOMEONE ELSE will! Then they’ll say THEY thought of it first when REALLY they just BOTTLED OUR SWEAT AND CUM and fermented it into an ENERGY DRINK.
lines.zh: 因为我们不干，别人就会干！然后他们会说是他们先想到的，可实际上他们只是把我们的汗和精液装瓶，发酵成了能量饮料。

lines.en: You don’t want to drink CUM and SWEAT, do you??? You want THE MEATS. Fatty, savory, succulent MEATS. The kind that come from HORSES and RHINOS and other things to make you feel STRONG.
lines.zh: 你不会想喝精液和汗吧？？？你想要的是肉。肥美、咸香、多汁的肉。那种来自马和犀牛之类的、能让你感到强壮的肉。

lines.en: You’re chasing after an UNACHIEVABLE high because that’s all the WEAK know how to do! But that all CHANGES with ARBY’S. Which changes with YOU!
lines.zh: 你在追逐一种无法企及的快感，因为弱者只会干这个！但有了 ARBY’S，一切都会改变。而 ARBY’S 随你而改变！

lines.en: The key to ESCAPISM isn’t ESCAPE! It’s having a DREAM. A REAL one. Not the kind you get from a BOX, the kind you get from a DISPLAY CASE of OTHER DREAMS that are CLOSE but not CLOSE ENOUGH.
lines.zh: 逃避主义的关键不是逃避！而是拥有一个梦想。一个真正的梦想。不是从盒子里拿到的那种，而是从陈列着别的梦想的展示柜里拿到的那种——很接近，但还不够近。

lines.en: ARE YOU STILL THERE? Or have you TUNED US OUT again?!
lines.zh: 你还在吗？还是说你又把我们屏蔽了？！

lines.en: Either way, FUCK YOU. Fuck your MOM. Fuck your DAD. Fuck your COUSINS and your DOG and your FAVORITE BAND because they aren’t ARBY’S.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，操你的。操你妈。操你爸。操你表亲、操你的狗、操你最爱的乐队，因为他们都不是 ARBY’S。

lines.en: EAT FRESH.
lines.zh: 吃新鲜的。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles1
: Hello and welcome back to whatever this is. I am here. Again. Because, for some reason, there is not {i}enough{/i} pain in my life and I must subtly seek it elsewhere.
lines.zh: : 你好，欢迎回到这个不知道什么东西的节目。我在。又是我。因为不知为何，我的人生还不够{i}痛{/i}，我得悄悄去别处找点痛来受。

lines.en: : My name is Wakana Watabe and I want to fucking die. And if you are watching this at home, you may take that as an invitation to come and put me out of my misery.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Wakana Watabe，我想死了算了。如果你正在家里看这节目，你可以把这句话当成邀请——来把我从痛苦中解脱吧。

lines.en: : Is that...Kabuterimon?
lines.zh: : 那是……Kabuterimon？

lines.en: : Hercules Kabuterimon. What is literally {i}any{/i} of this shit?
lines.zh: : Hercules Kabuterimon。这他妈到底{i}都是些什么{/i}玩意儿？

lines.en: : I’m getting there.
lines.zh: : 我正要说到。

lines.en: : Can we discuss how Yumi knows more about Digimon than me first?
lines.zh: : 我们能先聊聊为什么 Yumi 懂的数码宝贝比我多吗？

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles2
: No. Much like the first obstacle course we held, none of this makes any sense. And it once again starts with a ball pit because Imani thinks balls are funny.
lines.zh: : 不行。就跟我们办的第一届障碍赛道一样，这些玩意儿毫无逻辑。而它又一次从球池开始，因为 Imani 觉得球很好笑。

lines.en: : Funniest shape. No contest. Succeeded only by the heptagon due to rarity.
lines.zh: : 最好笑的形状，没得比。只有七边形因为稀有能排第二。

lines.en: : Contestants — we have once again hidden an assortment of items in the sea of balls. You must dive deep into its depths to retrieve your sales permit.
lines.zh: : 选手们——我们再次把一批物品藏进了球海里。你们必须潜进它的深处，找回你们的销售许可证。

lines.en: : Sales permit?
lines.zh: : 销售许可证？

lines.en: : That’s right. You will need it for phase two.
lines.zh: : 没错。第二阶段你们需要它。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles3

: After obtaining your sales permit, you must take it to the stall located to the right of the sea of balls and assume the role of an enslaved hawker who is unable to leave until they sell a single loaf of bread.
lines.zh: : 拿到销售许可证后，你们要把它带到球海右侧的摊位，扮演一个被奴役的小贩——在卖出一条面包之前无法离开。

lines.en: : Challenge accepted! I have fantasies that begin in similar ways.
lines.zh: : 接受挑战！我的幻想就是这么开头的。

lines.en: : You have fantasies about selling bread to escape slavery?
lines.zh: : 你的幻想是靠卖面包来摆脱奴役？

lines.en: : Close! My imagination is much worse.
lines.zh: : 接近了！我的想象要糟糕得多。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles4
: Oh no. It appears that a bread-hating dragon has suddenly attacked your town. Leave the stall and protect your village from danger by throwing a baseball into its mouth.
lines.zh: : 不好了。看来一条憎恨面包的龙突然袭击了你们的小镇。离开摊位，把棒球扔进它嘴里，保护你们的村庄免受危险。

lines.en: : I have to play a sport?! Also, that isn’t a dragon!
lines.zh: : 我得做体育运动？！还有，那根本不是龙！

lines.en: : Yeah, it's like a fuckin’ beetle or something, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊，那玩意儿看着像只他妈的甲虫什么的吧？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah. But there’s no way a single baseball could take it down! I vote that we skip this phase entirely!
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，对。可一个棒球怎么可能把它打倒！我建议这一阶段整个跳过！

lines.en: : Request denied. Attack its weak point for massive damage and move onto phase four.
lines.zh: : 请求驳回。攻击它的弱点造成大量伤害，然后进入第四阶段。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles5
: With the dragon defeated, a barrier must be cast over your village to prevent further attacks.
lines.zh: : 龙被击败后，必须为你们的村庄张开一道结界，以防再次遭到攻击。

lines.en: : This challenge is a standalone one unlinked to the other three phases and must be conquered using only your knowledge of magic and spellcasting.
lines.zh: : 这项挑战是独立的，与其他三个阶段无关，只能靠你们的魔法与咒文知识来攻克。

lines.en: : A-hah! And just like that, I’m right back in this!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！就这样，我又回到状态了！

lines.en: : If you can even figure out how to throw a baseball, you mean. Kinda fucked on progression if you can’t handle that much.
lines.zh: : 前提是你得先搞清楚怎么扔棒球。连这个都搞不定，后面就别想推进了。

lines.en: : That...is also my fear. Yes.
lines.zh: : 那……也是我担心的地方。是的。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles6
: Finally, once the barrier has been erected, you must meet with the village elder to obtain your reward.
lines.zh: : 最后，结界立起来之后，你们必须去见村里的长者，领取奖励。

lines.en: : This reward will be a point for your stupid war that you may then use to enslave Arakawa and make {i}him{/i} sell bread or something.
lines.zh: : 这份奖励是给你们那场蠢战争的一分，之后你们可以用它奴役 Arakawa，让{i}他{/i}去卖面包什么的。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles7
: And that’s it. Any questions?
lines.zh: : 就这些。有问题吗？

lines.en: : A few, yes.
lines.zh: : 有几个，是的。

lines.en: : Too bad. Go.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。开始吧。

lines.en: : Like...now?
lines.zh: : 就……现在？

lines.en: : The longer you spend standing here, the longer {i}I{/i} spend standing here. And there are few things I hate more than standing.
lines.zh: : 你们在这儿站得越久，{i}我{/i}就得在这儿站得越久。而我讨厌的事里，站着能排前几名。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles8
: {i}On it!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}马上！{/i}

lines.en: : Wha- since when are {i}you{/i} competitive?! You’re supposed to be the one girl from the first floor who always just surrenders at twenty! You don’t even {i}like{/i} the Supreme Overlord!
lines.zh: : 什——{i}你{/i}什么时候开始争强好胜了？！你本来该是那个一到二十就投降的一楼女生啊！你甚至{i}不喜欢{/i}至高霸主！

lines.en: : {i}No, but I do want to throw shit! So feel free to surrender yourself if you can’t handle getting your ass kicked!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不喜欢，可我确实想扔东西！所以你要是受不了被打得屁滚尿流，尽管自己认输吧！{/i}

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles9
: {i}I REFUSE TO GIVE IN! THE SEA OF BALLS IS NO MATCH FOR MOLLY MACCORMACK!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我绝不认输！球海根本不是 MOLLY MACCORMACK 的对手！{/i}

lines.en: : I am so tired of this place.
lines.zh: : 我对这个地方真是受够了。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles10
: That bug thing is really scary, Touka...I can’t read its thoughts at all.
lines.zh: : 那只虫子真吓人，Touka……我完全读不到它的心思。

lines.en: : Well, Yasu, that’s probably because it is a statue. And statues don’t have thoughts for you to read in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那个，Yasu，大概因为它是一尊雕像。而雕像本来就没有心思让你读。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles11
: But the turtle one {i}does{/i} and that’s why I’m so confused!
lines.zh: : 可那只乌龟{i}有{/i}啊，所以我才这么困惑！

lines.en: : At least this obstacle course seems a bit more...{i}thematical{/i} than ours was, Miku. What with the motif of protecting a village and everything.
lines.zh: : 至少这个障碍赛道看起来比我们那届更……{i}有主题性{/i}，Miku。毕竟有保护村庄之类的设定。

lines.en: : All I can really remember from our competition was gettin’ to light stuff on fire at the end. And also grabbin’ that big ole’ horse cock outta the sea of balls.
lines.zh: : 我们那届我只记得最后能点火烧东西。还有从球海里掏出那根老大的马鸡巴。

lines.en: : Female horses must have some crazy vaginas if they can handle all that dick meat. That true, Touka?
lines.zh: : 母马的下面肯定很厉害，才装得下那么多肉。是真的吗，Touka？

lines.en: : They’re called mares, Miku.
lines.zh: : 那叫母马，Miku。

lines.en: : Horse vaginas are called mares? Why?
lines.zh: : 马的下面叫母马？为什么？

lines.en: : That...{i}no.{/i} Female {i}horses{/i} are called mares.
lines.zh: : 那个……{i}不是{/i}。{i}母马{/i}才叫 mares。

lines.en: : Then what the heck are their vaginas called and how come you’re tryin’ to dodge my question?
lines.zh: : 那它们的下面到底叫什么，你干嘛一直躲我的问题？

lines.en: : The turtle is still thinking! It’s {i}watching!{/i} But the bug remains a mystery, Touka! I don’t know what I’m supposed to do!
lines.zh: : 那只乌龟还在思考！它{i}在看着{/i}！可那只虫子仍然是个谜，Touka！我不知道该做什么！

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles12
: What a coincidence. Neither do I.
lines.zh: : 真巧。我也不知道。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles13
: A-hah! Found it!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！找到了！

lines.en: : Does that really look like a permit to you, MacCormack?
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿在你眼里真像许可证吗，MacCormack？

lines.en: : Not {i}yet{/i} it doesn’t! But perhaps I can make this fairy grant us passage to the final challenge by thinking outside of the box and granting him the ability to speak via magic!
lines.zh: {i}现在{/i}还不太像！不过也许我可以让这只妖精放行我们进入最终挑战——只要跳出框框思考，用魔法赋予他说话的能力！

lines.en: : MacCormack, please don’t-
lines.zh: : MacCormack，拜托别——

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles14
: Im tur-'t actuallui ped- edhelen...
lines.zh: : Im tur-'t actuallui ped- edhelen...

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles15
: Hey, uhh...this ain’t that permit thing we’re lookin’ for, is it? Just looks like more balls to me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，呃……这不是我们要找的那个许可证吧？在我看来就又是一堆球。

lines.en: : That, uhh...no. I don’t think that’s it.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……不是。我觉得不是。

lines.en: : Why are they on a string?
lines.zh: : 它们为什么串在一根绳子上？

lines.en: : Imani, who keeps putting these things in the ball pit?
lines.zh: : Imani，到底是谁一直把这些东西放进球池的？

lines.en: : Hey, don’t look at me. Makoto’s the one with all the access to that stuff. Sides, there ain’t no way in hell I’d ever buy those. Noooo thank you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别看我。有门路搞到那些东西的是 Makoto。再说，我打死也不会买那种玩意儿。谢——谢了。

lines.en: : I’m, uhh...I’m gonna go back down now.
lines.zh: : 我，呃……我下去了。

lines.en: : Same.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles16
scene yumimollyobstacles17
: Got it! This time, I-
lines.zh: : 拿到了！这次我——

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles18
: Aww, what the fuck? It’s just more of these weird balls. Why are there so many of them in here?
lines.zh: : 啊，搞什么鬼？又只是这些怪球。这里面怎么这么多？

lines.en: : Eureka! One permit to sell baked goods! Straight from the Produce Delivery Administration itself!
lines.zh: : 找到了！一张烘焙食品销售许可证！直接来自农产品配送管理局！

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles19
: Bullshit! Bread ain’t a vegetable! Unless they moved the fuckin’ food groups around while I wasn’t paying attention!
lines.zh: : 扯淡！面包又不是蔬菜！除非趁我没注意，他们把他妈的食物分类改了！

lines.en: : Permission to engage in slavery, Miss Watabe?!
lines.zh: : 允许从事奴役行为，Watabe 女士？！

lines.en: : Haven’t you people done enough already?
lines.zh: : 你们这些人还没折腾够吗？

lines.en: : Go. The sooner this contest ends, the better.
lines.zh: : 走吧。这场比赛越早结束越好。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles20
: In that case, might I interest you in a loaf our {i}finest{/i} rustic bread, straight from the fiery mouth of a wood-fired communal?
lines.zh: : 既然如此，不知您是否有兴趣来一条我们{i}最上等{/i}的乡村面包，刚从 communal 柴火炉那炽热的炉口取出？

lines.en: : And yes, while it may {i}appear{/i} to just be {i}normal{/i} bread, {i}this{/i} bread was baked by Nedgread Redgrog, the greatest dwarven baker in all of Kumon-mi. They say his cooking level is maxed out, you know.
lines.zh: : 是的，虽然它{i}看起来{/i}只是{i}普通{/i}面包，但{i}这{/i}条面包出自 Nedgread Redgrog 之手——全 Kumon-mi 最伟大的矮人面包师。据说他的厨艺等级已经满级了，您知道吧。

lines.en: : Can you try selling it to me like a normal human?
lines.zh: : 你能不能像正常人一样卖给我？

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles21
: Ahh, so it is {i}human{/i} bread you’re after. And for that, you’ve come to the right place.
lines.zh: : 啊，原来您想要的是{i}人类{/i}面包。那您可来对地方了。

lines.en: : We sadly do not carry such a thing here, but for the price of just {i}one{/i} loaf of our own, I’d be willing to point you in the direction you’re looking for to-
lines.zh: : 很遗憾我们这儿没有那种东西，但只要买上{i}一{/i}条我们自己的面包，我就愿意为您指个方向——

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles22
: Yo! Goth teacher lady! I found my sales permit! Now, buy this bread or I’ll kick your ass!
lines.zh: : 喂！哥特风女老师！我找到我的销售许可证了！现在，买下这条面包，不然我就揍你！

lines.en: : Sold — to the girl in checkers.
lines.zh: : 成交——卖给那个穿格子的女生。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles23
: {i}Fuck yeah! Throwing shit!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}操，太爽了！扔东西！{/i}

lines.en: : What?! No! Buy my bread or {i}I’ll{/i} kick your ass too!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不！买我的面包，不然{i}我{/i}也揍你！

lines.en: : Unlikely. I believe I could take you even despite being partially handicapped. You’re going to have to try harder.
lines.zh: : 不太可能。就算我身上有部分残疾，我也相信自己能拿下你。你得再加把劲。

lines.en: : But Yumi didn’t have to try at all!
lines.zh: : 可 Yumi 一点都没费劲啊！

lines.en: : Her mom says she’s a natural salesperson! It’s probably just that, Molly! A girl whose name I definitely remember despite the green motif and flat chest!
lines.zh: : 她妈妈说她是天生的销售员！大概就是因为这个吧，Molly！一个尽管一身绿色主题、又平胸，我却绝对记得住名字的女生！

lines.en: : Stop hangin’ out with my fucking mom! It’s weird!
lines.zh: : 别再跟我妈混在一起了！很奇怪啊！

lines.en: : This bread possesses magical qualities! And if you eat it at home, it will add to your rested bonus and increase stamina generation for the next twenty-four hours!
lines.zh: : 这条面包具有魔法属性！如果您在家里吃，它会增加您的休息加成，并在接下来的二十四小时内提升体力恢复速度！

lines.en: : Boring. Too many words. Do better.
lines.zh: : 无聊。话太多。再接再厉。

lines.en: : Then...uhh...buy this bread or I will keep talking to you!
lines.zh: : 那……呃……买下这条面包，不然我就一直跟你说下去！

lines.en: : Sold. You may now proceed.
lines.zh: : 成交。你现在可以进入下一阶段了。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles24
: And I may go sit down as I imagine this next part will take one of you at least an hour.
lines.zh: : 而我也可以去坐下了，因为我想下一部分至少得花掉你们其中一个一小时。

lines.en: : Oh, jeez. Wonder which one of us she could be talking about?
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪。不知道她说的是我们中的哪一个？

lines.en: : How do I even hold these? The only thing I have experience throwing is competitive games when I’m forced to play DPS.
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿到底该怎么握？我唯一有「扔」的经验的，就是被逼着打输出位时把比赛扔了。

lines.en: : You just fuckin’ do it, Ireland. How hard could it be? Just pretend it’s a potato and maybe you’ll get over your fears or some shit.
lines.zh: : 你就他妈扔啊，Ireland。能有多难？就当它是个土豆，说不定你就克服恐惧了什么的。

lines.en: : Potatoes are for eating, not throwing! My ancestors who died during the famine would depart their graves just to kill me!
lines.zh: : 土豆是用来吃的，不是用来扔的！我在饥荒中死去的祖先会爬出坟墓来杀了我！

lines.en: : Well, {i}I’ll{/i} kill you if you keep distracting me! Hitting this target is harder than I thought!
lines.zh: : 那你要是继续分我的心，{i}我{/i}就杀了你！打中这个靶子比我想的难多了！

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles25
: You ain’t gotta throw it so fast, Yumi! You’ve gotta aim!
lines.zh: : 你不用扔那么快，Yumi！你得瞄准！

lines.en: : The fuck is “aiming?!” I’m just trying to knock this damn thing over!
lines.zh: : 「瞄准」是他妈什么？！我只想把这破玩意儿打翻！

lines.en: : Hey, Wakana. You seem to be having a good time.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Wakana。你看起来玩得挺开心。

lines.en: : Go fuck yourself, Arakawa. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 去你的，Arakawa。你想干什么？

lines.en: : Just checking in. I didn’t like your monologue earlier.
lines.zh: : 只是过来看看。你刚才那段独白我不喜欢。

lines.en: : What a coincidence. I haven’t liked anything you’ve ever done in our entire history together.
lines.zh: : 真巧。我们认识这么久，你做过的任何事我都没喜欢过。

lines.en: : Not even the times I let you cry on me?
lines.zh: : 连我让你靠在我身上哭的时候也不喜欢吗？

lines.en: : Arakawa, those are the times I hate most of all. Now, please let me cherish what I hoped would be a rare moment of silence in the midst of endless gunfire.
lines.zh: : Arakawa，那些时候是我最讨厌的。现在，请让我珍惜这难得的片刻宁静吧——在无休止的枪声中。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, I could stand here and repeatedly comment on how pretty you are.
lines.zh: : 或者，我也可以站在这儿，反复念叨你有多漂亮。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles26
: And risk angering the childhood friend that you supposedly love so dearly? Don’t make me laugh.
lines.zh: : 冒着惹怒那个你口口声声深爱着的青梅竹马的风险？别逗我了。

lines.en: : I’ve heard that you’re practically her lap dog now. Which means you’d have {i}no{/i} problem dumping me if she so much as asked you to.
lines.zh: : 我听说你现在基本上就是她脚边的小狗了。那意味着只要她开口，你{i}一点{/i}问题都没有就会把我甩了。

lines.en: : Wakana...that’s not {i}jealousy{/i} I’m hearing, is it?
lines.zh: : Wakana……我听到的该不会是{i}嫉妒{/i}吧？

lines.en: : It’s one thing to live a second life outside of our friendship. That, I can handle. But to hear that she’s trying to work her way {i}in{/i} to your inner circle does frustrate me a little, yes. I wouldn’t call it jealousy, though.
lines.zh: : 在我们的友谊之外过第二种生活，那是另一回事。那个我能接受。可听说她正试图{i}挤进{/i}你的核心圈子，确实让我有点恼火。不过我不会把这叫嫉妒。

lines.en: : Well, what would you call it then?
lines.zh: : 那你会怎么称呼它？

lines.en: : Not wanting to hear Imani bitch about it when you start disappearing into the restroom with a different girl.
lines.zh: : 不想听 Imani 因为你开始跟别的女生一起消失在洗手间里而发牢骚。

lines.en: : The solution here is that we all just go in there together.
lines.zh: : 解决办法就是我们大家一起进去。

lines.en: : You sound like a drunken party girl. Get a grip, already.
lines.zh: : 你说话像个喝醉的派对女郎。清醒点行不行。

lines.en: : Fine. Just you and me then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就只有你和我。

lines.en: : In the restroom? I think not. I’ve done quite a good job of minimizing my online presence and the last thing I need is some idol painting a target on my back out of jealousy on {i}her{/i} end.
lines.zh: : 在洗手间里？我看不行。我已经很努力地把自己的网络存在感降到最低了，我最不需要的就是某个偶像出于{i}她{/i}那边的嫉妒在我背上画靶子。

lines.en: : Fine. Then you get Niki and I get Imani. Or you get Imani and I get Niki. Or I get you and Imani gets Niki.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那你分到 Niki，我分到 Imani。或者你分到 Imani，我分到 Niki。或者我分到你，Imani 分到 Niki。

lines.en: : And what role does Rika play in all of this?
lines.zh: : 那 Rika 在这当中扮演什么角色？

lines.en: : She can rotate between both groups.
lines.zh: : 她可以在两组之间轮转。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles27
: Why will you not just let me rest?
lines.zh: : 你为什么就是不让我清静一下？

lines.en: : Some of my worst thoughts come when I’m “resting.” I’m just trying to distract you from yourself.
lines.zh: : 我一些最糟的念头就是在「清静」的时候冒出来的。我只是想让你别老想着自己。

lines.en: : Stop being nice. It’s making me nauseous.
lines.zh: : 别对我这么好。让我犯恶心。

lines.en: : Want to go for a walk once the contest is done?
lines.zh: : 比赛结束后想去走走吗？

lines.en: : Depends. Would you like to carry me?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你想抱我吗？

lines.en: : I could. Sure.
lines.zh: : 我可以。当然。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles28
: Then no thank you. The thought of being alone with you when that is on your mind does little to make me feel safe.
lines.zh: : 那就不用了。一想到你脑子里转着那种念头、还跟你独处，我就一点安全感都没有。

lines.en: : Now, please leave or I will have to contact security and say you’ve been taking inappropriate pictures of the girls in the gym.
lines.zh: : 现在，请离开，否则我就得联系保安，说你在体育馆里给女生拍不适当的照片。

lines.en: : They’re probably the ones taking inappropriate pictures of me at this point.
lines.zh: : 到这地步，大概反倒是他们在拍我的不适当照片。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I wish it was our school that had suddenly and mysteriously sunk into the earth.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我真希望突然神秘沉入地底的是我们学校。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles29
: Excellent job knocking over the Hercules Kabuterimon, Yumi. It made it much easier for me to get the ball into the beast’s mouth.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你把 Hercules Kabuterimon 打翻得漂亮。这让我把球弄进那头野兽嘴里容易多了。

lines.en: : You could’ve tried a little harder than just walking over and dropping it in, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你本来可以更努力一点，而不是直接走过去把球丢进去。

lines.en: : I could have, aye. But instead, I elected to save my energy for the final phase. Not everyone is fit to cast spells, you know.
lines.zh: : 我本可以的，唉。不过我选择把力气留给最后阶段。不是谁都适合施法的，你知道吗。

lines.en: : The incantations are tough as is, but that doesn’t even touch upon the physical strain that the expenditure of one’s mana places on the body.
lines.zh: : 咒文本身就已经很难了，更别提消耗魔力给身体带来的负担了。

lines.en: : Okay, well, you’re the fuckin’ nerd here and I already got through the fun part. So just do whatever you want, I guess. I’ll just watch and make fun of you.
lines.zh: : 好吧，反正你才是那个书呆子，而好玩的部分我已经过了。所以你爱干嘛干嘛吧。我就在这儿看着嘲笑你。

lines.en: : Heh,  you seem to believe that I’m vulnerable to vicious mockery. But the truth is that I’ve developed an immunity over the years that makes me all but impervious to it.
lines.zh: : 呵，你似乎以为我会被恶毒的嘲笑伤到。可事实是，这些年来我已经产生了免疫力，几乎对它完全免疫。

lines.en: : Aight. I’ll just kick the shit out of you if you get too annoying then.
lines.zh: : 行吧。那你要是太烦人，我就把你打得满地找牙。

lines.en: : New idea — I’m just going to try casting some spells.
lines.zh: : 新主意——我干脆试着施几个法术。

lines.en: : Yeah, you do that.
lines.zh: : 行，你施吧。

lines.en: : {i}Munita sum...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Munita sum...{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Custodi hanc domum!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Custodi hanc domum!{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}Ego invoco deus ab mihi! Protego mihi ab hostili et malum!{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}Ego invoco deus ab mihi! Protego mihi ab hostili et malum!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Praesidium!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Praesidium!{/i}

lines.en: : You’re really good at this.
lines.zh: : 你真的很擅长这个。

lines.en: : M-Maybe I’m...{i}not{/i} supposed to be casting a defensive incantation? Maybe I need to...use an offensive one to spur the orb to action instead?
lines.zh: : 也……也许我{i}不该{/i}念防御咒？也许我该……用攻击性的咒文来促使那颗宝珠启动？

lines.en: : Or maybe you just suck at magic.
lines.zh: : 或者你就是魔法很烂。

lines.en: : Well, I’d like to see {i}you{/i} try! Like I said, the strain this puts on one’s body is not something to be scoffed at! You’d have likely collapsed from exhaustion by now!
lines.zh: : 那我倒想看看{i}你{/i}来试试！就像我说的，这给身体带来的负担可不是闹着玩的！你大概早就累趴下了！

lines.en: : Maybe just be better. That should help, right?
lines.zh: : 也许你只要变强点就行了。那应该有帮助，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Propria manu...resurgam!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Propria manu...resurgam!{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Semper fortis! Semper liber! Tuebor!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Semper fortis! Semper liber! Tuebor!{/i}

lines.en: : Abra kadabra.
lines.zh: : Abra kadabra。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles30
: Wha...no! This can’t be!
lines.zh: : 什……不！这不可能！

lines.en: : Told you. You just suck. And I’m better at magic than you.
lines.zh: : 说了吧。你就是很烂。而且我魔法比你好。

lines.en: : I...Impossible! I’ve been practicing these incantations for years! All that effort...just to be defeated by the one magicians use to pull rabbits from a hat?! How will that protect my village?!
lines.zh: : 我……不可能！我练这些咒文练了好几年！那么多努力……就败给了魔术师从帽子里掏兔子的那句？！这要怎么保护我的村庄？！

lines.en: : Beats me, but I’m going to go claim my reward now. Sorry, Ireland.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道，不过我现在要去领奖励了。抱歉啦，Ireland。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles31
: {i}No!!!! Noooooooooooo!!!!!!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}No!!!! Noooooooooooo!!!!!!{/i}

lines.en: {i}told you it would work. now speak to the weird fucking turtle thing so we can get out of here and go back to being best friends.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我说过会管用的。现在去跟那个奇怪的乌龟玩意儿说话，这样我们就能离开这儿，继续当好闺蜜了。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t know how many times I need to tell you that you’re not my friend, but here. I’ll tell you again right now. You’re not my friend.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还得告诉你多少次你不是我的朋友，不过行吧。我现在就再说一遍。你不是我的朋友。

lines.en: if i’m not your friend, how come we’re always spending so much time together?
: Oh, I don’t know. Because you live inside of my fucking {i}head,{/i} maybe?
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道。也许因为你住在我他妈的{i}脑子里{/i}？

lines.en: {i}or maybe you just like me — and you look forward to the way i think for you so you don’t have to think for yourself.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}又或者你其实就是喜欢我——还期待着我替你思考，这样你就不用自己动脑子了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}things are tough now, aren’t they? not knowing whether your mother will live or die. not knowing where you and chika stand as friends.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在日子不好过吧？不知道你妈妈是死是活。不知道你和 chika 的朋友关系到底算什么。{/i}

lines.en: {i}and that’s not even mentioning how you have no idea if you’ll ever get to suck akira’s fat teacher-cock like it’s the meatiest popsicle in the whole wide-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}更别提你根本不知道自己有没有机会把 akira 那根粗大的老师鸡巴当全世界最厚实的冰棒来-{/i}

lines.en: : Wise turtle...instead of a point for the Dorm Wars, could you use your mysterious turtle powers to vaporize Pareidolia, please?
lines.zh: : 智慧龟……除了给宿舍战争的一分之外，能不能用你神秘的海龟之力把 Pareidolia 蒸发掉？

lines.en: : Such a feat is beyond my power. But I will grant you victory and thank you for the affection you show my kind.
lines.zh: : 此等壮举超出了我的能力范围。不过我会赐予你胜利，并感谢你对我族类所展现的喜爱。

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles32
: Holy fuck.
lines.zh: : 我操。

lines.en: {i}holy fuck.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我操。{/i}

lines.en: : You actually talk?
lines.zh: : 你真的会说话？

lines.en: {i}it actually talks?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}它真的会说话？{/i}

lines.en: : We didn’t just mutually imagine that, did we?
lines.zh: : 我们不是一起幻想到那个了吧？

lines.en: {i}we might have. shit’s so weird around here sometimes that i don’t even know anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也许是吧。这鬼地方有时候怪到我自己都不清楚了。{/i}

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles33
: Okay, so...the Wise Turtle has spoken. Which means Yumi wins and my job here is done.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那么……智慧龟发话了。也就是说 Yumi 获胜，我在这儿的工作也结束了。

lines.en: : You guys didn’t put, like...a speaker in that turtle or something, did you?
lines.zh: : 你们没有在那只乌龟里装个……扬声器什么的吧？

lines.en: : That sounds like effort to me. And, much like Arakawa, I’m allergic to effort. So no.
lines.zh: : 那听起来需要费力气。而就像 Arakawa 一样，我对费力气过敏。所以没有。

lines.en: : R...Right...Yeah. Guess I’ve seen some...weirder shit anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 是……是吗……好吧。反正我也见过更……怪的东西，所以……

lines.en: scene yumimollyobstacles34
: {i}Hah...{/i}that brings us to the end of our eighth competition. But also to the beginning of my nap time.
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}这让我们第八场比赛就此结束。同时也意味着我的午睡时间开始了。

lines.en: : Please stay tuned for the barista...thing...at Koi Cafe, coming up after this brief word from our sponsors.
lines.zh: : 请继续收看稍后在 Koi Cafe 举行的咖啡师……那个……比赛，就在简短的赞助商广告之后。

lines.en: scene black
{size=-10}It’s so cold on the moon.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-10}月亮上真冷。{/size}
